added_lines: the month of october has been designated as a special time of prayer for vocations to the priesthood in the diocese of kerry. week three focuses on those on mission. crossing the sea "brendan sailed where maps ended." brendan never knew exactly where god would lead him. neither do we. mission begins whenever we choose love over fear, faith over comfort, hope over despair. god still sends ordinary people to accomplish extraordinary things. missionary disciples go where god asks the rosary is prayed every night at 7pm in holy cross church. everyone is welcome to join
